scripts.build:storefront: tsc -b && VITE_APP_TARGET=storefront VITE_APPLE_TOUCH_ICON=/apple-touch-icon.png VITE_APP_ROBOTS='index,follow' VITE_APP_TITLE='OptiBlue | Óptica y oftalmología en Venezuela' VITE_APP_MOBILE_TITLE=OptiBlue VITE_APP_URL=https://optiblue-prod.web.app VITE_STOREFRONT_URL=https://optiblue-prod.web.app vite build --outDir dist-storefront
scripts.build:panel: tsc -b && VITE_APP_TARGET=panel VITE_APPLE_TOUCH_ICON=/panel-apple-touch-icon.png VITE_APP_ROBOTS='noindex, nofollow' VITE_APP_TITLE='OptiBlue Panel' VITE_APP_MOBILE_TITLE='OptiBlue Panel' VITE_APP_URL=https://optiblue-panel.web.app VITE_STOREFRONT_URL=https://optiblue-prod.web.app vite build --outDir dist-panel && npm run smoke:panel-build
scripts.build:all: npm run build:storefront && npm run build:panel
